observations.behavior: Replaces a fixed 3-column grid header with a container-query-aware, responsive header; adds a container query class, a header ref, and conditional accessibility hiding; changes the tab bar to support horizontal scrolling and explicit start alignment; retains the recording button and tab triggers.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the ExceptionCard UI in the Error Tracking frontend to handle narrow split-pane widths and narrow mobile screens, preserving the tab bar and recording button while allowing the tab list to scroll and hiding the exception label when space is insufficient.
